name: Basellandschaftliche Kantonalbank
summary: Basellandschaftliche Kantonalbank provides various banking products and services to the private and corporate customers in Switzerland. It offers private, current, capital deposit, rent, tenant savings, and club accounts; corporate, structured, and real estate financing; investment for entrepreneurs; trading and currency services; foundations, institutional clients, and external asset managers; fixed term deposit and call money investment; foreign exchange; and physical precious metal accounts.
